data.title: 爱西亚 · 卧室烛光下的圣洁献身
data.description: 安静的烛光卧室内，黑色修女头巾早已褪去，如瀑金发散落床榻。胸前长袍纽扣完全解开，露出白皙无瑕的幼嫩香肩。爱西亚双手合十紧贴在颤抖的心口前，含泪向你献上全部的纯洁。
data.location: quiet candlelit bedroom with fluttering sheer curtains
data.action: kneeling on white bedsheet with veil removed, habit fully unbuttoned exposing virginal pale chest, hands clasped over chest whispering breathless vows of love
data.lighting: soft flickering golden candlelight creating intimate reverent shadows
data.mood: sacred romantic consummation, virginal tremor, absolute selfless love
data.promptProse: Kneeling on white sheets with an unbuttoned nun habit, Asia blushes heavily with clasped hands, declaring eternal love in soft candlelight.
data.animaCaption: Asia Argento kneeling with unbuttoned nun habit in romantic candlelight.
